run_cpu_graph_runner: run the CPUGraphRunner class to execute model forward passes with CPU torch.compile
capture_cpu_graph_batch_sizes: capture CPU graphs for a list of batch sizes using torch.compile on the model forward pass
register_fake_cpu_ops: register fake meta implementations for custom sgl_kernel CPU operators to support torch.compile
set_torch_compile_config: configure torch._dynamo and torch._inductor settings for CPU graph compilation
replay_cpu_graph_inference: replay a captured CPU graph for inference with a given forward batch and optional hidden state capture
